question: How does this approach compares to the state-of-the-art results on these tasks?
title: Contextual Joint Factor Acoustic Embeddings
answer_short: The CJFA encoder performs significantly better in both phone classification and speaker recognition tasks compared with other two approaches.
answer_rationale: The document states in the Results and Discussion section (Text 45) that the CJFA encoder obtains significantly better phone classification accuracy than the VAE baseline and also than the CJFS encoder. These results are replicated for speaker recognition tasks. The Conclusion and Future Work section (Text 53) further confirms that CJFA performs significantly better in both tasks compared with other approaches.
